prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat pyproject.toml && ls -R src | head -50 && (mypy src 2>&1 | tail -80)

cat -n src/trailhead/elevation.py && echo ---- && cat -n src/trailhead/pace.py && echo ---- && cat -n src/trailhead/report.py && echo ---- && grep -rn "elevation\|ele_\|smooth\|def \|None" src --include=*.py | head -80
cat -n src/trailhead/track.py && echo ---- && ls tests && grep -rn "None\|ele" tests | head -40; ls; cat README* 2>/dev/null | head -80; git status --short
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; grep -n "ele\|elevation" src/trailhead/plan.py src/trailhead/cli.py | head

mypy; echo "mypy exit $?"; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; ruff check src 2>&1 | tail -3; python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from trailhead.track import parse_track
from trailhead.report import summarise
t=parse_track('lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,130\n')
print(summarise(t))"
